dimensions.rationale: Actual help and residual water debts, older food/heat deprivation and supply operation do not settle current ordinary combined net access.
dimensions.assumption: Real water/energy help and residual debt/older deprivation retained; no current ordinary median combined net water-food-energy direction; bill example not annualized, group rates not median.

dimensions.rationale: Actual public coverage, routine patient-reported observations, specialist treatment and implemented improvements coexist with long waits/child-care continuity failures; finite usual care60, assumptions explicit.

dimensions.rationale: Mature disease-class human evidence and actual local academic CAR-T routine use/followup support limited readiness60 with revocable ordinary payment/monitoring bridges, not healthy antiaging.
dimensions.assumption: Finite mature ARI disease-class/human/local actual routine adoption and monitoring plus ordinary coverage/eligibility/resources/net support/temporal bridge; specific current product-payment decision and all personal net costs not directly closed, weakest revocable link. Research funding not all routine payment, no foreign payer transfer/fixed adult/per-dose invoice gate; reject=>null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual knowledge-to-clinical production, active firms and real clinical/utility digital adoption support finite diffusion60, not universal resident coverage.
dimensions.assumption: Revocable local/core-FUA/time/usual-device-resource-diffusion bridge from actual clinical manufacturing/adoption, active spinouts and ordinary digital use; contracts not unique residents, research count not rank, coverage/common-power gaps remain.

dimensions.rationale: Domestic operation, legal mobility, payments and fair-use roaming are components; ordinary international operating exit and longterm continuity remain insufficient.
dimensions.assumption: Actual local transport/EU legal and payment/ordinary roaming components not full normal international exit and durable new-address continuity; no added bank-receipt gate.
